Subject: Post-demo: Security questionnaire initiation & SOC 2/HIPAA clarifying questions

Hi Sam / Priya —

Thanks again for your time on the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side to get the security intake moving: 

- We can start with a SIG Lite (prefill) or a full SIG/CAIQ depending on how deep your security team wants to go.
- Per discussion, two immediate clarifying items we need to confirm:
  1) SOC 2: Do you require a current SOC 2 Type II report for production access, or is a SOC 2 summary and attest sufficient for initial evaluation?
  2) Data residency / HIPAA: Do you expect HealthSprint data to remain in US regions only? Also confirm whether we need a BAA in place before any POC activity.

If you prefer we can attach a short questionnaire bundle (SIG prefill + redwood SOC2 summary) and a scheduling link for a 30-min evidence walkthrough with our security team. I attached a one-page SIG request template below for your legal/security to sign (HealthSprint_SIG_Request.pdf).

Proposed immediate next actions:
1) You confirm SOC 2 requirement (full report v summary) and residency/BAA expectations.
2) If SIG prefill is acceptable, sign and return the request PDF and we’ll open the intake in our vendor portal.
3) I’ll loop in Laura from Legal if you need contract touches.

Thanks — I’ll wait for a quick thumbs up and we’ll move forward the same day.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0162
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com

Hi Olga —

Thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers from our side: 
- SOC 2: For procurement, we need the full SOC 2 Type II report before final sign-off, but for the initial POC your SOC 2 summary + controls mapping is acceptable. The procurement team will request the full report during contract negotiations.
- HIPAA/Residency: HealthSprint is US-only for PHI. We need a signed BAA before any PHI ingestion; for the POC we can use synthetic data if the BAA is still in process.

We’re comfortable with starting on a SIG prefill to speed things up. I’ll have Priya (security lead) review the prefill and the request template — we should be able to get that back within 48 business hours.

One ask: can you attach a short matrix that maps the SIG/CAIQ sections to the SOC 2 controls you’ve implemented? That will help our security engineer triage faster.

Sam
